notes: Flex band: changes within the band are file-and-use, larger ones need prior approval. Closest of the three: File and Use.
Prior approval under Proposition 103; intervenors can request a public hearing for increases above 7%.
Insurer may choose file-and-use or use-and-file; under use-and-file, premiums from a later-disallowed rate must be refunded (Fla. Stat. 627.062).
Prior approval with a rating bureau (NC Rate Bureau files base rates for the market); insurers may also use 'consent to rate' above bureau rates.
Prior approval, but homeowners changes under 5% may be use-and-file once per calendar year per company.
Prior approval, but changes within +/-7% may be filed and used.
File-and-use since 2003 (SB 14); TDI may disapprove after review.
Open rating: no filing review (GAO marks approval time 'not applicable'). Closest of the three: Use and File.
